game.name: Armored Core For Answer (Europe)(En,Fr,Es)
game.desc: Armored Core for Answer on Xbox 360 is an action game that can be played both in single and multiplayer mode, whether in co-op or versus. You control huge mechs that are tasked with taking on a lot of enemies in a fun and entertaining way. The title invites you to confront giant fortresses that you must dismantle in all directions in order to update the core and destroy it.
